dedupe_keys.name: constructing a dataset of monthly air passengers at german airports based on publicly available monthly reports

description: Constructing a Dataset of Monthly Air Passengers at German Airports Based on Publicly Available Monthly Reports is a data set deposited in Harvard Dataverse by its authors Laurenz Krueder. The Excel Document provided in this dataset contains helpful formulas for researchers who wish to extend the data either into the past or the future. The document serves as a tool which structures and facilitates the time-consuming process of preparing and collecting data from monthly PDF reports. Coverage: national (DE); the metadata date the deposit to 2021. Formats: Excel, Image. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC0 1.0. Caveats: written from the Dataverse search and dataset metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-hdv-repository.
